_about: Public-domain John Gill (1697-1771, Baptist, Carter Lane, Southwark) for the Word Hoard. The Body of Doctrinal Divinity, the Body of Practical Divinity and the Exposition of Solomon's Song clean from CCEL; The Cause of God and Truth (London: Tegg, 1838) and A Collection of Sermons and Tracts (London: G. Keith, 1773, 2 vols) as raw Internet Archive OCR. Added 2026-10-02 by lane A, round 4 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
